description: Have you noticed these epic works of street art around Sydney? They're all hiding in plain sight - you just have to know where to look.  Tell us where to find your favourite street artwork in the comments below. Artwork featured in order: 1. Jenny Munro mural by Matt Adnate on 20 Dixon Street, Sydney 2. The Night Sky by Jacob Nash at Pier Street underpass, Darling Harbour 3. Aspire by Warren Langley on the corner of Fig and Allen streets, Pyrmont 4. Data.scape by Ryoji Ikeda at the International Convention Centre, Darling Harbour 5. In Between Two Worlds by Jason Wing on Little Hay Street, Factory Street and Kimber Lane, Haymarket 6. Tree of Life by Xia Hang on Harrison Lane, Ultimo 7. Balfour Street mural by Matt Adnate and Eric Mangen on Teggs Lane, Chippendale 8. Bin Chickens by Scott Marsh on Teggs Lane, Chippendale 9. Danny Lim mural by Scott Marsh and Blends on Abercrombie Street, Chippendale 10. Native Bouquet by Scott Marsh on Cleveland Street, Darlington 11. Displacement by Apeseven on Vine Street, Redfern 12. Forgotten Songs by Michael Thomas Hill in Angel Place, Sydney 13. Untitled by unknown on Mary Street, Newtown 14. Woman with Telephone by Fintan Magee and Numskull on Church Street, Newtown [Video description: Video opens with a quick cut of several street artworks located around Sydney. Text on screen reads: Epic Sydney Street Art. The video continues to show panning shots of different street art beginning with the Jenny Munro mural, a large painting of Aboriginal Elder Jenny Munro, which is 20 metres tall and appears on the side of the Novotel in downtown Sydney. This is followed by many more artworks including Aspire in Pyrmont, a series of tall glowing yellow trees that sit under an underpass, Forgotten Songs, a collection of metal birdcages which hang high above the ground in Angel Place. The video ends with an untitled mural by artists Fintan Magee and Numskull, which features a painting of a woman 4 metres high on the side of a building in Newtown. The woman is wearing a blue, buttoned blouse and holding a tin can to her ear connected to a piece of string like a telephone. description: Everyone has a hidden side of themselves they don’t want to reveal. This is why I create art—because few things feel as sincere as the marks made on a piece of paper. I stand tall. I create with courage and compassion. I work hard to prove to myself that I’m stronger than what once sought to define me. Vulnerability is a source of strength, yet I am afraid of it being misconstrued as a desire for attention. Self doubt cuts deep. Inadequacy and comparison feels like an addiction. Old wounds follow me no matter how far I run. Inevitably, I end up back in the same place, feeling as helpless as I did years ago.  They say it’s time to let go — but how do I even begin to love myself?  #art #healing #drawing

description: What stirs the soul more deeply than a journey through time? The Mocănița of Maramureș, a narrow-gauge steam train, threads its way through the wilderness of Vaser Valley—a realm suspended between autumn’s last golden sigh and the iron grip of winter. Here, the past lingers like the faint scent of woodsmoke, entwining itself with the crystalline air. The train’s whistle echoes through frost-laced evergreens, a haunting hymn that awakens the spirit of an old-world Romania, where folklore and nature are eternal bedfellows. This locomotive relic, built in 1932, huffs and puffs its way through 21 kilometers of untamed terrain. Originally tasked with transporting timber from the forest, today it carries wanderers hungry for romance and nostalgia. The ancient wheels clatter over tracks hemmed by steep cliffs and river gorges, the landscape untouched by the ceaseless march of modernity. Steam unfurls like a diaphanous veil, mingling with the low-lying mists of the valley, creating an otherworldly tableau that begs for both poetry and reverence. Few places on Earth still breathe with such primordial vigor. As you watch the world pass through rain-streaked windows, it feels as though time itself has slowed. Locals wave from rustic homesteads, their lives bound to the land and its rhythms, while forests whisper stories of unseen creatures and age-old legends. The Mocănița isn’t just a train—it’s a portal to the sublime, a rare chance to revel in the marrow of an unspoiled world. Would you embark on this journey, knowing that its beauty lies in the fleeting and the ephemeral? description: все новинки в тгк: RichKids Store🍭  African Diaspora Goods, Denim Tears' New York flagship, opened on March 15th, 2024. The store’s design was a collaborative effort between Denim Tears’ founder, Tremaine Emory, and Theaster Gates, an award-winning multidisciplinary American artist and urban planner. Gates, whose art translates the intricacies of Blackness through space theory, land development, sculpture, and performance, has extended the role of the artist as an agent of change through the expansiveness of his approach as a thinker, maker, and builder. Among his many notable artistic and conceptual projects are his “land art” and creative placemaking demonstrations, which he famously undertakes through his Rebuild Foundation, where Gates purchases derelict homes and buildings on Chicago's South Side, transforming and reactivating them into affordable housing, community greenspace, artist studios and residencies, creative entrepreneurship incubators, and archival laboratories for both neighbors and visitors. Inspired by Gates’ decades-long artistic practice of archiving, elevating, and making publicly accessible historic Black images and objects, the store also serves as a community space housing a collection of over one thousand, five hundred publications on the history of the Arts of Africa longside the label’s seasonal collections. description: If you haven’t tried condensed milk in your espresso yet, you’re seriously missing out…  Here’s how to make it: 1. Start by adding a generous layer of condensed milk to the bottom of your cup (you can find it at most grocery stores). 2. Add 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 2 tbsp milk, and a pinch or two of salt. 3. Whisk it all together until it’s smooth and creamy.  For the espresso: 1. I use 20g of beans for the perfect shot, pulling about 40g of espresso.  2. Fill your cup with ice, then pour in 1/2 cup of milk.  3. Slowly pour the espresso close to the surface of the milk for that perfect pour.  Top it off with your creamy condensed milk mixture and a light dusting of powdered chocolate.  Now that’s an espresso drink worth savoring! It kind of has a Tiramisu vibe, don’t you think? description: So what is a “Living museum”? A living museum is a museum that still functions as its ORIGINAL PURPOSE. Not only is Toronto’s first post office a museum but it’s also a FULL SERVICE CANADA POST. So what’s pretty cool is locals & tourists alike can visit and use it as it was originally intended. If you’re vacationing to Toronto this is a fun stop to add to your itinerary and admission is PWYC to the museum! BONUS FUN FACT: the final clip showcases the accessible entrance to the post office. If you require the accessible entrance it’s about 15m North on the east side of the St. George & Adelaide intersection. You will see a black gate which is unlocked during business hours. You can push open the gate and it will take you into the back courtyard (which is super cute). You should then see the accessible ramp.  SUPER EXTRA FUN FACT: Every second Sunday of the month the post office hosts a letter-writing & calligraphy club in the reading room. If you are a fan of  letter writing you are MORE THAN WELCOME TO JOIN.  #toronto #todotoronto #historic #canadapost #livingmuseum #torontostreets

description: If you’re ever in Guadalajara don’t miss Bosque Los Colomos — it’s like stepping into a peaceful forest right in the middle of the city. This urban forest spans over 90 acres and offers a peaceful space for walking, running, or simply reconnecting with nature. Just what I love! Jog, stroll, feed the ducks, or just chill in the gardens. They have a cute Japanese garden with koi ponds. You can even ride horses or explore cool nature trails. They have a castle, but unfortunately it was closed when we were there. “El Castillo,” is a historic building turned cultural center where art and dance classes are held. Colomos is the perfect place to relax, recharge, and appreciate nature in the city. The entrance is free, but they do charge for parking. description: Hey dog lovers! Have you always wanted to bring your dog with you to visit a museum? Well now is your chance! Bring your pup, on a leash, to the Museum for an evening of pets and art. The first 50 people get a free fetching dog bandana AND you can have your portrait taken by Cal Poly Photography Club member Henry Connolly. While you and your best friend stroll through the Museum, you can enjoy free wine, dog treats, and tunes by Flutter by Cam.   As an added bonus, visitors who bring a donation of a bag of dog or cat food for Woods community pet pantry or bring a bag of jerky type dog treats for the shelter pups at Woods Humane Society during the event can get 50% off a SLOMA Individual or Family yearly membership. description: 🇲🇾这家Cheras的牛杂，也太好吃了🤤 今天介绍给你们一家Cheras的隐藏牛杂店，真的特别好吃！刚刚才听老板说，卤味的做法是跟🇨🇳师傅学来的，难怪那么香、那么入味。🤤 沙煲牛杂 真的是完全被惊艳到！牛肉滑嫩到不行，配上浓郁又香的汤底，简直绝配。牛筋Q弹软糯，完全没有腥味，肉质新鲜，和汤底融合得刚刚好，吃第一口就爱上了。 沙煲卤鸡脚 鸡脚卤得超入味，咬下去软糯又有Q感，卤汁香气十足，不咸不油腻，越嚼越香，真的越吃越上瘾。 卤套（鸡腿，豆腐，鸡蛋） 鸡腿软嫩入味，豆腐吸满卤汁，咸香适中，鸡蛋是老卤做法，蛋黄不会干，一整套配白饭，真的超级下饭。 除了卤味、牛杂，这里还有猪肉圆面、鱼圆面、牛肉丸面而且竟然还有牛肉、羊肉、鸡肉水饺，选择超多！不管想吃饭、吃面、还是点小吃，这里都能满足。 而且老板人很好，蛮健谈的，聊几句就觉得很亲切，让人吃得开心，心情也特别好。 📍蕉赖茶餐室 RESTORAN KAFE CHERAS 528-G, Batu 3 1/4, Jln Cheras, Taman Pertama, Cheras, 56100 🕰️ 16pm-12am #隐藏美食 #Cheras美食 #吉隆坡探店 #马来西亚必吃 #吃货的天堂 #本地吃货必试 #美食控必看 #超火美食店 #吃货种草 #牛杂控必试

description: Guide to visiting teamLab Planets Tokyo, Japan!😍✨🌺💎 This museum has a world full of interactive digital artworks that changes based on the presence of people.  There are 4 large scale artwork spaces (indoor) and 2 gardens (outdoor) to experience. Prepare to explore the museum barefoot as some areas involve walking through water up to knee depth. Certain areas also have mirrored floors. Be mindful of your clothing - wear shorts or pants you can be sure to roll up. There are lockers if you need to change & store personal items. Visitors follow one path from room to room. You can download the teamLab app to interact with the art. Artworks to expect during your experience include: - The Infinite Crystal Universe - Koi Pond - Drawing on the Water Surface Created by the Dance of Koi and People - Spheres of Light - Expanding Three-Dimensional Existence in Transforming Space - Flattening 3 Colors and 9 Blurred Colors, Free Floating - Floating in the Falling Universe of Flowers - Floating Flower Garden  - Glowing Moss Garden - Moss Garden of Resonating Microcosms - Solidified Light Color, Dusk to Dawn - Soft Black Hole - Waterfall of light particles at the Top of an incline.    Admissions to teamLab Planets Tokyo cost 3,600 JPY ($23) If you’re hungry don’t miss out on their Vegan Ramen UZU shop right outside the museum! teamLab Planets Tokyo takes about an hour and a half to complete. Thank you for your creativity!  This is Episode 3 of my series where I uncover Tokyo’s most underrated neighborhoods 💌  Today’s Episode: Kiyosumi-Shirakawa ☕️🎨🪴 If you’re looking for a quiet, artsy side of Tokyo that’s still off most tourist radar — Kiyosumi-Shirakawa is the perfect place to explore. Located 15 minutes from Ginza, this riverside neighborhood is known for its slow-paced charm, artisan coffee scene, and small galleries and boutiques. Once an old warehouse and factory district, this neighborhood is now known among locals for their charming warehouse cafes, traditional gardens, and curated bookstores. 🍃☕️ Here are 3 local favorites you shouldn’t miss while you’re there:👉  Kiyosumi Garden – a beautifully preserved traditional Japanese garden with a large pond, stone paths, and perfectly manicured pine trees. Come early in the morning for peace and stunning views of the koi and turtles 🐢👉  le bois – a minimalist café and gallery space tucked away in a quiet corner of the neighborhood. Great for specialty coffee, pastries, and a cozy place to journal or read 📖👉  Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo (MOT) – one of Tokyo’s top art museums, featuring cutting-edge exhibitions from Japanese and international artists. 📌 Save this post for your next trip to Tokyo & follow @mytokyolife_ for more hidden gems around the city 💕 #tokyo  #kiyosumishirakawa  #TokyoTips  #TokyoNeighborhoods  #Cafes  #TokyoTravel  #Sweets  #TokyoCafes

description: #urbex #exploremore  --- **Urban Exploration (Urbex)** Urban exploration, often called *urbex*, is the activity of exploring abandoned or hidden man-made structures. These places can include old factories, deserted houses, tunnels, hospitals, or even rooftops of skyscrapers. Many people who practice urbex are passionate about history, architecture, and photography. Urbex is not just about adventure. It allows explorers to discover forgotten places and imagine the lives of the people who once lived or worked there. Many urbex enthusiasts take pictures to document their visits, creating beautiful and sometimes eerie images of decay and time. However, urbex also involves risks. Buildings may be unsafe, with broken floors or falling ceilings. Sometimes, exploring such places is illegal, especially if the site is private property. That’s why the urbex community often follows an unwritten rule: “Take nothing but pictures, leave nothing but footprints.” In conclusion, urbex is a fascinating way to rediscover the hidden side of cities, but it requires respect, caution, and responsibility.

description: 肇庆｜沉浸在白鹭的世界里，与自然共舞 白鹭不同于海鸥，海鸥喜人，拿点面包就飞过来了，白鹭可是有自己的生活方式的，虽不怕人但也不喜人多；肇庆的鹭鸟生态园反而是刚刚好！ 景区很小众，以观鸟为主，游人自然不多，以至于大部分的游乐设施都荒废了，春节期间也只有小火车和游船在开着；虽说颇为可惜，倒也很适合这里栖息的几万只白鹭，试想人头涌涌的风景区里怕也看不到这么多的鸟了吧？！ 跳上观光小火车，铁轨蜿蜒穿行于花海与鹭群之间。车铃叮当，惊起一片白羽纷飞，小火车载着笑声掠过水畔，仿佛驶入宫崎骏的动画世界。湖心的木舟随波轻晃，船夫竹篙一点，穿行在鸟岛之间，看鸟儿们忙碌于觅食，孵蛋，搭巢，玩闹，一阵风过，鹭鸟归巢的身影掠过天际，如墨笔勾勒的写意画～ #肇庆白鹭 #自然生态 #小众旅行 #观鸟天堂 #宫崎骏世界

description: I love the rain so, so much. 🌧️ My love for it has been with me for as long as I can remember. As a kid, I welcomed it with open arms—running outside barefoot, twirling under gray skies, and letting it soak into every inch of me. And even now, that hasn’t changed. I still pause when I hear the first drops, watching them race down the windowpane, letting their familiar rhythm settle deep into my bones. Rain has a way of turning ordinary days into something softer—whether it’s wandering through misty woods or curling up at home with a warm drink. When it’s not falling, I find ways to bring it closer—filling the air with soft rain sounds as I lose myself in a good book. So, this is my love letter to the rain. 💌 You are more than just a passing storm; you are a feeling, a presence, a piece of me. In autumn, you turn the world golden and crisp, weaving through falling leaves with the scent of earth. In winter, you are soft and steady, tapping against frosted glass while I stay tucked beneath a blanket. Spring belongs to you in all the best ways—fresh and full of promise, bringing life to blooming trees and filling the streets with puddles. And summer, oh summer rain, you arrive in bursts—sudden, warm, electric—turning even the hottest days into something refreshing. You are there for the stillness and the adventure, for quiet mornings and wild afternoons. You remind me to slow down, to breathe, to enjoy the simplest moments. I’ll never stop being in awe of you. ❄️🌷🌞🍂 - I’d love to make more little love videos like this for my favorite things—autumn, hobbies, and all the simple joys that fill my heart. What’s something simple and inanimate that you love? Maybe it’s the glow of candlelight, the feeling of flipping through a well-loved book, or the comfort of your favorite sweater. description: 槟城地道的🇻🇳越南面包&浓厚咖啡 ！道地人一吃就爱上！早上4点现做！一天卖100粒越南法棍真的夸张！ 4月19日-24日，5月1日-4日 ！ 买越南面包还送越南咖啡！ 这家【Banh Mi 77】开了还不到半年的小店，还没吃过就真的走宝了！越南老板娘每天凌晨4点开始做面包，坚持用越南进口食材，从法棍到咖啡、炼乳，全部都是真材实料！越南烧肉、火腿、串烧超好吃！越南🇻🇳咖啡好喝到停不下！而且听说也好多越南人都爱去这家买面包呢 他们的越南法棍一共有6种款式，15种以上配料可以搭配。华人最爱烧肉口味，越南人则偏爱火腿跟猪肉串，咬一口香气四溢、外酥内软，真的太好吃了！ 老板娘说她开这家店，就是希望把越南人熟悉的味道带到槟城这里给更多人尝试到，也让在大马生活的越南同乡可以吃到正宗家乡味。吃完面包再配一杯浓浓越南咖啡，早上瞬间醒神又满足，连我这个不是越南人都爱上了～ Banh Mi 77 📍84, Jalan Siam, 10400 George Town, Pulau Pinang ⌚️9:30AM-8:30PM #槟城 #siamroad #banhmi77 #越南法棍 #越南面包 #美食 #槟城早餐 #槟城午餐 #正宗越南面包 #越南 #越南咖啡 #越南美食  #槟城越南面包  #槟城越南餐 #槟城美食

description: ”Metempsychosis: The Passion of Pneumatics“ by Ivana Bašić at Schinkel Pavillion Berlin. On view until September 1, 2024. From the exhibition text: Charged by the artist’s childhood experiences of war, violence, brutality, and physical entrapment during the collapse of her native Yugoslavia in the 1990s, Bašić’s humanoid sculptures address sweeping themes of intergenerational trauma, post-humanist feminism, and the quest for immortality, but these far-reaching subjects are refracted through the disarmingly tender bodies in her work, clinging to support structures such as pipes and prosthetics that hold them in place. In the center of the exhibition is a seven-meter-wide, site-specific sculpture that will take up the entire first-floor hall. At the core of this sculpture, between two large lobes of glass, small pneumatic metal hammers are gradually pounding an alabaster stone into dust — merging with the floating clouds of dust already inhabiting the exhibition space. Driven by air-pressure, the hammers’ repetitive movements are timed to the cadence of the artist’s breath, evoking the Gnostic idea of the Pneuma,”breath” and “spirit” in Greek. In the teachings of Gnosticism, the Pneumatics were the highest order of beings — those powered by the “breath of life”, the spirit that transforms beyond the material realm. #contemporaryart #berlin #exhibition #ivanabasic #schinkelpavillion #otherworldly #art #arttok #thingstodoinberlin #installationart #sculpture #machineart

description: Let's talk about what no one wants to admit: Caffeine and its half-life. If you've had caffeine today, you're probably setting yourself up for disrupted sleep, whether you realize it or not. Here's the breakdown: caffeine has a half-life of around 6 hours, meaning it takes that long for just half of it to leave your system. If you drank coffee at 10 AM, by 10 PM you'd still have 25% of that caffeine in your system. Think about that. Would you drink a quarter cup of coffee right before bed and expect to sleep well? Of course not. Yet, that's exactly what your body is dealing with. The problem isn't just the caffeine itself-it's how disconnected we've become from understanding our own physiology. Poor sleep will compound into dysfunctional movement, hormonal imbalances, and chronic fatigue over time. If you care about your long-term health and performance, the question isn't "Did you have caffeine today?" but rather, "Why are you relying on it in the first place?" Thanks to Dr. Moran MD for bringing up this fact about caffeine that so many seem to want to gloss over. #functionalpatterns #fpisthestandard #projectfunction #caffeine #coffee

description: Enjoy dog-friendly trails and spectacular views at this Perth urban bushland park. Just 8km from the city, Bold Park is a suburban bush sanctuary offering a peaceful escape with over 442 hectares of coastal native bushland to enjoy. Whether you’re a nature lover, fitness enthusiast, or just need a quiet place to unwind, Bold Park’s stunning Tuart and Banksia woodlands, towering jarrah and marri trees, and limestone heaths make it a must-visit. With over 15km of walking trails and 10 scenic lookouts, it’s easy to forget you’re still in Perth! Reabold Hill, the highest natural point along the coast, features an accessible boardwalk leading to a viewing platform with breathtaking 360-degree views of the city and beyond. Bold Park is also home to diverse native plants, wildlife, and wildflowers that bloom throughout the year - especially in spring! 🌼 If you’re up for a workout, you’ll love the hills scattered throughout the park. Try the popular 5.1km Zamia Trail for ocean views and glimpses of ancient zamias, or challenge yourself with the shorter but steeper 1.1km Tuart Walk under the shade of towering trees. Prefer to explore at your own pace? Mix and match trails for a custom adventure! All trails are limestone-based with mostly hard-packed paths, but some areas may be a little sandy or uneven underfoot. Look out for signposts at intersections to guide your way. Here’s what to keep in mind for your visit: 🚻 There are NO toilet facilities inside the park - the nearest ones are at the adjoining Perry Lakes Reserve. 🅿️ The larger Tuart Carpark (off Perry Lakes Drive) provides a convenient entry point to trails. 🐶 Dogs are welcome on a lead - just make sure to clean up after them. 🌼 All plants and animals are protected, so please leave them untouched for others to enjoy. 🥾 Stick to the marked trails to help preserve the park’s natural beauty. Whether it’s a leisurely walk, heart-pumping hike, or just some time outdoors with your dog, Bold Park is the perfect spot to reconnect with nature! . . . . . . . #perthlife #Perth #hiking #bushwalking #boldpark #westernaustralia #hikingtrails  #dogfriendly

description: 上海必打卡地旅游攻略｜如何5天4夜完成20个打卡点？（3）-玩转不收费古镇 昨天有网友丝～我，上海有没有不收钱的地方？这不，体验且为你整理出来了👇👇   朱家角古镇 🌹推荐理由： ✅上海毕竟属于中国江南，我想在这种大魔都下一定要有那种叫“小桥流水人家”的温婉吧？ 果真，在朋友的带路下，来到不收费的朱家角古镇👏 一进来，整体的脚步就开始不自觉的慢下来，满满的烟火气，我想这才是心灵的归处！你值得体验一下 ✅其次，朱家角被称为美食聚集地，果然名不虚传！👍都是老上海的传统口味：什么汤圆、面食等等而且也非常的包容噢 ⭐强推一：阿婆肉粽 阿婆家咸蛋黄大肉	粽，居然只要7.5r。真的肉很大块瘦肉结结实实的，拉丝清晰可见!吃到下面一颗大蛋黄!糯米也非常有味道	!阿	婆家还有红烧扎肉，不过没有尝试 📍地址:朱家角镇北大街264号 ⭐强推二：不过，在这里真的非常强推👍赵小姐的茶🍵 玫瑰花茶、茉莉花茶…总之想养生茶找她就对了 还有好多好玩好吃的，一定要来体验一下感受都市下的慢生活 #上海旅游 #朱家角古镇 #美食分享 #上海必打卡20个地点 #上海古镇

description: There’s something about the night — the way it holds silence, the way it hides chaos, and the way it listens without judgment. In this moment, I’m not just standing under the sky… I’m standing under memories, under dreams, under every unspoken word I never said. The stars don’t speak, yet they say so much. The darkness doesn’t scare me — it calms me, because in the quiet of the night, I hear the loudest truth: *who I really am*. I don’t need loud lights to shine. I don’t need a stage to feel seen. In this one frame, it’s just me — real, raw, and unfiltered. No masks. No edits. Just a soul looking up, searching, maybe healing. This isn’t just a photo. It’s a reminder:   - To stay grounded even when I dream high.   - To find peace in chaos.   - To be the calm in the storm.   - To love the quiet and trust the process. Not everyone will get it. And that’s okay.   Because this moment — this energy — isn’t for attention.   It’s for alignment.   If you're reading this, remember:   You don’t need to be loud to be powerful.   You don’t need to be seen to have worth. And sometimes, the deepest growth happens in the darkest hours. Stay silent. Stay strong.   And when it’s time — *shine so loud, even the stars pause to admire you*. —   #DarkAesthetic #MoodyVibes #LateNightThoughts #LostInTheStars #SilentPower #AloneButNotLonely #NightPhotography #CinematicShot #DeepSoul #MenWithMood #EmotionalEdge #HealingJourney #DreamerVibes #Introspective #DarkVibes #SoulInShadows #EyesToTheSky

description: Gerçek adı Can David Bayram olan Pashanim, Kürt kökenli Alman rap sanatçılarından biridir. 2000 yılında Berlin'de doğan sanatçı, genç yaşlardan itibaren hip-hop kültürüne ilgi duymaya başladı. Berlin'in sokaklarından gelen enerjiyi ve yaşam tarzını müziğine yansıtan Pashanim, kısa sürede Almanya rap sahnesinde adını duyurmayı başardı. 2018 yılında rap yapmaya başlayan Pashanim, özellikle 2020 yılında çıkardığı "Airwaves" adlı parçasıyla büyük bir çıkış yakaladı. Bu şarkı Almanya'da listelerde zirveye yükselerek TikTok ve diğer sosyal medya platformlarında viral hale geldi. Şarkının başarısı, Pashanim’i Almanya'daki en popüler genç rapçilerden biri haline getirdi. Müziğinde melodik beat'ler ve akıcı flow’lar kullanarak kendine özgü bir tarz oluşturan sanatçı, şarkılarında genellikle gençlik kültürü, sokak hayatı ve Berlin’in atmosferini anlatmaktadır. "Sommergewitter" ve "Kleiner Prinz" gibi hit parçalarıyla da büyük beğeni toplayan Pashanim, minimalist prodüksiyon tarzı ve lirik yapısıyla dikkat çekmektedir. Bağımsız olarak müzik yapmayı tercih eden ve büyük plak şirketleriyle anlaşma yapmayan Pashanim, kendisi gibi bağımsız sanatçıları destekleyen rap kolektifi Playboysmafia'nın bir parçasıdır. Sahneye nadiren çıkması ve gizemli imajını koruması, hayranları arasında ona olan ilgiyi daha da artırmaktadır. Kendi tarzını ve kimliğini bozmadan müzik yapmaya devam eden Pashanim, Alman rap sahnesinde yükselişini sürdürerek yeni nesil sanatçılar arasında önemli bir yere sahip olmayı başarmıştır.

description: Let me tell you a little story about why this moment means so much to me💙 8 years ago I worked in the Manchester Arndale Lush just below this Waterstones. On my breaks, I would come to this shop and sit in the cafe as I dreamed of being an author. I’d daydream, buy book after book on each shift, and it truly became my place of peace. A few years later when I first wrote Heavenly Bodies, I would walk in again, and imagine seeing my book one day in the shop. I was indie published then and thought it was nearly impossible.  Now, today, I got to walk in to a bookshop that I feel like has seen me through my entire twenties, and all manner of professions, and I got to see my book, on its own table, right near the entrance 😭 This was the exact image I held in my mind for so many years, and the fact that today I got to experience this dream I’d held in my heart for so long is just surreal. I’m crying writing this! It’s thanks to so many people that I was able to do this today, and i’m just so grateful. I feel beyond blessed and lucky to have such amazing readers who spread the word about this book and support me. It started HERE on TikTok, and look how far we’ve come. And a huge thank you to the lovely booksellers Chloe, Charlie, Ellie and Gemma who came and spoke to me and let me sign ALL these books. And the lovely customers who stopped by and picked up a copy as I was signing 🥹💙 You can get a signed copy now at Waterstones Manchester Arndale 🥰⭐️ @waterstonesarndale  #fyp #fairylootromantasybox #fairyloot  #booktok #enemiestolovers #CapCut #bookrecs #books #bookish #bookworm #booktoker #wattpadstories #spicybooks #fantasyromance #heavenlybodies #acotar #fbaa #bookrecommendations #romancebooks #authorsoftiktok

description: Juniper Springs and Campground is one of the most popular campgrounds in the Ocala National Forest. The location offers deeply shaded sites within walking distance of the STUNNING natural springs which some say hold medicinal properties.  While I’ve stayed at the campground many times and always enjoy it you can also come for the day for $15! You can bring food with you and grill on the charcoal grills. There are areas with picnic tables scattered throughout the springs area and it’s super chill. There are signs that alcohol is not permitted and dogs are also prohibited from the springs area only.  The bathrooms were pretty clean considering.  There is a camp store that has quite a few items if you may have forgotten something like a toothbrush etc. There’s also snacks, drinks, merch AND you can rent Kayaks!  The boardwalk is STILL closed and has been for years. And with the price increases here I REALLY wish they would get this done because it’s a huge missing piece of the gem of a place.  Pro tip: Go early before the crowds! Like right when it opens.  For more info go to the website: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation 📍 26701 FL-40, Silver Springs, FL 34488 #hiddengems #hiddengem #floridahiddengems #florida #ocala #ocalafl #springs #floridasprings #ocalanationalforest #floridacamping #kayakflorida

description: This colourful interactive exhibition at the Ferens is the perfect place to take the kids this Half-Term! 🤩 It’s called Microworld, created by a UK-based digital art collective Genetic Moo, and it’s transformed part of the gallery into a bright, colourful space packed with huge digital projections that respond to your movements! The artwork is alive with weird and wonderful creatures, and as you move around, they react to you and each other. Each microorganism has its own task and purpose, from hiding and sleeping in the shade to eating colours, and watching them all react to your image is really fun! There are even nods to other artworks in the gallery hidden among the creatures, a great way to get the kids into the wider gallery as they try to find all the references. There’s also a sensory play area called the Microlab where younger visitors can explore, play and learn as they study the strange digital lifeforms around them. It’s completely free to visit and runs all summer until 7 September, with intermittent events like family-friendly craft activities and print-making to get stuck into, and even dance parties - with SEND versions too. Full details 👉 https://hullwhatson.com/events/microworld/ Give us a follow to discover more great events like this around Hull & East Yorkshire! #hull #interactiveexhibition #artgallery

description: 🇲🇾 Puchong新开cafe|竟然有沙滩区打卡 还没开张时在外面经过就被招牌吸引了🤩 上个周末正式开张就立马去探店🥳 店内空间舒适宽敞，有ID设计美美的可以打卡📸 我注意到有很多插座，来这里办公也不错🤭 食物方面蛮多样化的，除了早餐/西餐，也有中餐、Nasi lemak等等… 饮料方面除了咖啡，也有花茶、水果茶等等… 价格合理，跟一般café 差不多。 我们盲点了几份食物，U1S1，味道还真不错，品质在线😋 点了一杯巧克力的饮料个人觉得还好，但是咖啡确很不错，很香醇！ Matcha也很浓郁！ 原来这是Penang的牌子，在Penang/Kedah/Sabah有好几家分店了…  Puchong这家是雪隆d1家，应该陆续有来… 🤭 📍 Daily Coffee 🚗 20, Jalan Puteri 1/5, Bandar Puteri, 47100 Puchong, Selangor. ⏰Daily 8am-12am #puchongcafe #puchong美食 #puchong咖啡厅 #puchong好去处 #puchong必吃 #puchong美食探店 #puchong网红咖啡馆 #klcafe #蒲种公主城 #bandarputeri #吉隆坡cafe #朋友聚会 #puchong早餐 #puchong午餐 #puchong晚餐 #咖啡控 #周末好去处 #不吃醋的特蕊丝

description: 朱柳莉是中国著名的国礼画家，以她的工笔画和刺绣作品闻名。她在艺术领域取得了显著的成就，以下是她的一些主要艺术成就和贡献： 1. **工笔画大师**：朱柳莉擅长工笔画，其作品细腻精致，色彩丰富，常常描绘花鸟鱼虫等自然题材，展现了极高的艺术造诣。 2. **刺绣艺术家**：她不仅擅长绘画，还精通刺绣艺术，将绘画与刺绣完美结合，创作出许多精美的刺绣画作。她的刺绣作品色彩鲜艳、针法细腻，受到广泛赞誉。 3. **国礼艺术家**：作为国礼画家，朱柳莉的作品被选作国家礼品，赠送给外国政要和贵宾。这不仅体现了她个人的艺术成就，也代表了国家对她艺术才华的认可。 4. **艺术教育**：朱柳莉在艺术教育领域也做出了重要贡献，她致力于培养新一代艺术人才，传授工笔画和刺绣技艺，推动传统艺术的发展和传承。 5. **文化交流**：通过参与国际艺术展览和文化交流活动，朱柳莉为中外文化交流做出了积极贡献，提升了中国传统艺术在国际上的影响力。 6. **作品收藏**：她的作品被许多博物馆和美术馆收藏，如中国国家博物馆、故宫博物院等。这些作品不仅展示了她个人的艺术成就，也为公众提供了欣赏和学习的机会。 朱柳莉在艺术创作、教育和文化交流等方面的卓越贡献，使她成为中国当代艺术界的重要人物。她的艺术作品既保留了传统的精髓，又融合了现代的创新，具有很高的艺术和文化价值。#手绘画艺术 #朱柳莉 #国礼画家 #国画 #名画

description: Un museo da visitare a Napoli  A hidden gem that few tourists know! This unique museum is located inside the Palazzo Como, an elegant Renaissance building that houses the precious collection of Gaetano Filangieri, prince and great patron of the eighteenth century. Founded by Gaetano Filangieri, the museum represents a real treasure chest of art, history and culture. The intention of the Filangieri was in fact to create a place where art and knowledge could be accessible to all, contributing to the education and cultural growth of Citizens. 📍 Filangieri Museum, via Duomo 288, Napoli. Curiosity 👀: The Como palace is also called "the walking palace". During the construction of Corso Umberto I at the end of the 19th century, the palace risked being demolished or incorporated. To avoid its destruction, the building was dismantled and rebuilt stone by stone, but in a slightly more backward position, as if it had "Walked" to avoid his fate. description: 📍The Louvre Museum in Paris, France, is one of the world’s most famous and visited art museums.  Here are some interesting facts about the Louvre: 1. Historic Palace: The Louvre was initially built as a royal palace in the 12th century, making it one of the world’s oldest and most iconic palaces. 2. Art Collection: The Louvre houses over 38,000 objects, including some of the world’s most famous works of art, such as the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, and the Winged Victory of Samothrace. 3. Mona Lisa’s Smile: The Mona Lisa, painted by Leonardo da Vinci, is one of the most recognised and celebrated artworks in the world. It is displayed in a climate-controlled, bulletproof glass case to protect it. 4. Glass Pyramid Entrance: The iconic glass pyramid at the main entrance was designed by architect I. M. Pei and opened in 1989. It has become a symbol of the Louvre and modern Paris. 5. Size and Scope: The Louvre is one of the largest museums globally, covering an area of 72,735 square meters (782,910 square feet). Navigating the museum’s extensive collection can take days. 6. Medieval Moat: The Louvre was initially constructed as a fortress and was surrounded by a moat. Some remnants of the medieval moat can still be seen in the museum’s basement. 7. Theft of the Mona Lisa: In 1911, the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre by an Italian handyman. It was missing for two years before being recovered and returned to the museum. 8. Palace of Napoleon: During his reign, Napoleon Bonaparte used the Louvre as his royal residence and made extensive contributions to the museum’s art collection. ‼️On the first Saturday of each month, the Louvre offers free admission to its permanent collections for visitors under 26.  @louvre museum  Save and FOLLOW me for more amazing places❤️ . . #travel #louvre #museum #paris #france #travelplaces #travelphotography #fyp #tiktoktravel

description: So you wanna promote your band’s show by hanging posters around town?  Ryan (AKA TV-MA), Midtopia’s Street Team Manager, has some tips for you to help you build good relationships with local shops/places where you might want to promote. It’s so vital for local musicians to be able to promote their shows with physical promotion materials, but there’s also some do’s and don’ts to the art, to make sure you’re being respectful and mutually beneficial to our local businesses. Tips For Street Team Etiquette: Flyers  1. Introduce yourself to the manager or owner of the shop/business 2. Ask if you can put up flyers at their location 3. Take down any out-of-date flyers to make room for new ones. 4. Recycle old flyers 5. Find a size-appropriate spot that has good visibility and/or foot-traffic 6. Hang up your flyer with whatever is the best for the spot (tape, tacks, or staple gun) and hang it up making it look as clean as possible. 7. Thank the business! (Bonus points: if you take a pic/vid of the hanging flyer to promote on your band’s socials, tag the business in it to cross-promote for them, there, as well!) Good luck with the promo!  - - ✍️Follow @Midtopia for more original music content from local and regional bands and musicians + Local show info + educational tips and guides for DIY bands and music workers like this! - - - - - - - #localshows #DIYband #DIYmusician #DIYmusic #localmusicscene #ict #band #singersongwriter

description: How did I not know about @a_furry_affair? This is a proper pet cafe in the east where pets are allowed inside their air-conditioned cafe! How cool is that. Most of the time, we have to sit outside in the heat at pet-friendly places but this one allows you to go in with your pets. 😍😍😍 It’s a pretty big cafe with a gated corner on the first floor and another gated area in the back where the dogs can run free. Or you can keep them leashed to the carabiners on the ground. This place is really designed for pets, with doggy bowls for you to use and a menu of pet-friendly dishes like nuggets, boneless drumlets, steak and spaghetti. I ordered the Pawsome Meal for Bruno with beef cubes and a blueberry smoothie and he loved it. Don’t worry there’s food for humans too! Burgers, pasta, fish, coffee, alcohol even.  A Furry Affair is open every day, from 10am to 10pm from Sunday to Thursday, and 10am to midnight from Friday to Saturday. description: A true hidden gem in the Bay Area 😍 Nestled in the scenic hills of Danville, the @blackhawkmuseum stands as a captivating homage to automotive history and cultural heritage. It was established in 1988 by businessman and philanthropist Kenneth Behring. The museum initially focused on showcasing Behring's extensive collection of automobiles, including rare and historically significant models. Over the years, the museum expanded its scope to encompass not only classic cars but also a diverse array of exhibits that celebrate the intersection of automotive design, art, and culture. The museum features six exhibits: the Classic Car Collection, Art of Africa, Pat’s Compact, Into China, World of Nature, and Spirit of the Old West. The museum's ambiance, coupled with the passion evident in the meticulously curated displays, made my visit a memorable experience. Whether you are a car enthusiast or someone seeking a taste of the past, the Blackhawk Museum is a captivating destination that transcends the ordinary, inviting you to marvel at the beauty of these timeless machines. 📍Blackhawk Museum,  3700 Blackhawk Plaza Cir, Danville, CA 94506 @blackhawkmuseum  🗓️Open Friday - Sunday 🕰️10 am - 5 pm 🎟️Entry fee - $15 Have you heard of this museum? description: Japan Best Christmas Winter Illumination Spots to visit in 2024 📍Tokyo 📍Azabudai Hills NOV 23 ~ DEC 25 What to expect There are around 17 food and drink stalls (incl. vegan options), a 12-meter-tall Christmas tree shining with 20,000 LED lights, and shops stocking wreaths and other festive trinkets. The venue, the central square of Azabudai Hills, is draped with golden lights and a truckload of decorations. If you feel chilly outside, try one of the limited-edition dishes at a nearby restaurant. For 2024, there will be a photo-spot walk boasting selfie spots and even more decorations. 📍Tokyo Disneyland NOV 15 ~ DEC 25 What to expect At Tokyo Disneyland, enjoy a fantasy-filled Christmas with beautiful decorations, including a glittering Christmas tree. Guests of all ages are invited to experience a delightful and heartwarming holiday season. From November 15 through December 25, 2024, Tokyo Disneyland Electrical Parade Dreamlights will be presented in a special version exclusively for the Christmas event period. 📍Ebisu Garden Place NOV 9 ~ FEB 23 2025 What to expect Featuring a 10-meter-tall Christmas tree, a giant crystal chandelier, and a whole load of lights, The Baccarat Eternal Lights at Yebisu (Ebisu) Garden Place is one of the fancier displays of the season. Along with the Christmas tree, row of lights, and chandelier, the Christmas market is back for the first time in a while. Borrowing inspiration from European Christmas markets, it will take over both squares at Yebisu Garden Place and feature mulled wine, hot chocolate, hearty meals, and trinkets. 📍Roppongi Hills NOV 7 ~ DEC 25 What to expect There will be around 800,000 LED lights. Mohri Garden will be lit up and the Christmas Market will return. There will be several types of Christmas trees, including a flower-inspired tree at Roku-Roku Plaza. The illuminations begin in mid-November and will run until December 25, shining from around 5 p.m. to 11 p.m. each night. 📍Toramon Hills Business Tower NOV 23 ~ DEC 25 What to expect The Station Atrium on the B2 floor of the Toranomon Hills Station Tower will host the "MUUUSE CHRISTMAS EXPERIENCE" in conjunction with "MUUUSE: MUSIC MUSEUM (hereafter "MUUUSE")" held at "TOKYO NODE"*. A giant boombox over 2m tall will appear at the venue. It is an experiential installation where you can enjoy music that colors Christmas in Toranomon. Please spend a relaxing time listening to music with a collaboration menu with "MUUUSE" at the adjacent Toranomon Hills Cafe. In addition, Toranomon Hills'  official character "Toranomon" will be transformed into a Christmas version to welcome you. Together with the wreaths decorated at the entrance of the tower, it will liven up the Christmas mood. In addition, commercial stores will offer limited gourmet food such as Christmas cakes, stollen only available at this time of year, and sweets that will brighten up the holy night. description: 东京装逼圣地？劝退国立新美术馆的三大理由  #东京看展避雷   #穷游劝退指南   #日本旅行真实测评  	 🖼️ 免费展区仅1个 | 分展馆连环收费制 🖼️ 建筑大师设计≠内容惊艳（美术馆设计者黑川纪章在中国最著名的作品：郑东新区） 🖼️ 同样的票价能在上野看3个国字头！ 小红薯们听我含泪总结： 想看硬核展品请直奔国立博物馆（成人1000円） 想带孩子玩去科技馆（展品互动性天花板） 想拍光影大片再考虑这里（安藤忠雄清水墙确实出片） 每个独立展厅单独售票（500-2000円不等） 入场就像开盲盒 建议提前官网查当期展览 今日唯一免费厅10分钟逛完 付费的"XX现代艺术展"看得我瞳孔地震 终于理解那句话—— "艺术的门槛不是审美，是钱包厚度" 📌省流总结： 建筑控/摄影党可冲外立面 想看真迹建议移步上野三件套 学艺术贵不贵我不知道 但这里的票价确实有点小贵贵～💸  #东京美术馆刺客   #旅行防坑指南   #日本自由行攻略   #国立新美术馆   #艺术展打卡

description: ⚠️ Hoh Rain Forest is open I'm very picky and can’t be completely amazed by every “nice” location I visit, but Hoh Rain Forest is truly unique. It’s a must-visit destination a least once in your life.  Some tips for your visit:  — Bring waterproof gear like a rain jacket and water-resistant boots. Even if the forecast is clear, the forest can be damp. The forecast on my visit showed completely sunny weather, and you can see the result. — Explore the popular Hall of Mosses Trail (0.8 miles) and the Spruce Nature Trail (1.2 miles). description: 🍂 Waris Dırıe’nin gerçek yaşam hikayesi… Kitabı dün okumaya başladım ve bugün bitti. O kadar güzeldi ki…Yıllar önce filmini izlemiştim. Kitabını okumak daha bir farklı olduğunu söylememe gerek yoktur. Konumuz ise;  Güçlü bir başarı hikayesi… ‘Kadın sünneti’ kız çocuklarının doğumundan 5 yaşında kadar yapılan kötü bir uygulama. Kadın üreme organının kısmen ya da tamamen canlı canlı jiletle kesilmesidir. İğne ucu kadar boşluk bırakılır. Düşünün bu iğrenç olay hala devam ediyor. Amaç kadının cinselliğini kontrol altına almaktır. Namus göstergesi olarak uygulanan bu durum kız çocuklarının ölmesine bile sebep olur.  Waris Dırıe de 3 yaşındayken sünnet edilen bir kadın ve 13 yaşındayken deve karşılığı yaşlı bir adamla evlendirilmek istendiğinde ise yaşadığı çölden annesinin izniyle tek başına  yürüyerek kaçar. Geride anne özlemi kalır..Yanına sığındığı akrabalar ise sadece onu hizmetçi olarak kullanır. Taa ki keşfedilene kadar. Waris çok güçlü bir kadındır asla ama asla pes etmez. Kendi deyimiyle “ Somalili bir göçebenin Revlon modeline dönüşmesi” bu etkileyeci başarı hikayesini birebir kendi cümleleriyle okumak çok güzeldi. Hayatı BBC tarafından belgesel olarak 1995’te ‘New York’ta Bir Göçebe’ adında çekilmiştir. Waris, kadınların kendiyle aynı durumu yaşamasınlar diye mücadele vermiştir. Eser sade ve anlaşılır bir dilde kolayca okuyabilirsiniz. Bir günde okuyup bitireceğinize eminim. Ama etkisi uzun sürecek bir hikaye.. Okuyun, okutun… Kitap ve sevgiyle kalın 🎈 #reklam değil tavsiyedir. #çölçiçeği #warisdirie #kadınsünneti #kadın #kadınhakları #kitapreels #oyasiyeoy #ınstagramreels #kitaptavsiyeleri #women #reading #bookstagram #ilovebooks #bilgekültürsanat

description: It’s also well known for another naughty exhibit. Did you see it?  Think you’ve seen all of London’s museums? Bet you haven’t been here. This is the Petrie Museum — and it’s one of the capital’s best-kept secrets Tucked away in UCL, this place is packed with over 80,000 objects from ancient Egypt and Sudan — we’re talking mummies, pottery, amulets, even ancient underwear. Yep, you heard that right It’s named after Flinders Petrie — one of the most influential (and controversial) archaeologists of the 19th century. His work laid the foundations for modern Egyptology, and the museum’s stuffed with pieces he excavated The vibe? Wonderfully old-school. No interactive screens, no café — just endless rows of glass cabinets and handwritten labels. It’s like walking through someone’s very dusty, very eccentric private collection It’s free to visit, super central, and honestly? Way more atmospheric than most of the bigger museums. If you’re into ancient history or just want a break from the crowds, this is your spot Hidden gem status: confirmed.  #londonxlondon #hiddengemslondon #londonhiddensecrets #secretlondon #visitlondon #londonhistory #discoverlondon #bloomsburylondon #quirkylondon #ancientegypt

description: 槟城亚依淡的这个菜市场几十年来一直人气旺盛，成为了当地社区生活的重要组成部分。尽管岁月流逝，环境有所变化，但市场的热闹景象从未减少。老一辈的人们带着他们的回忆逐渐离去，而年轻一代也开始接过接力棒，继续光顾这里。 这市场不仅是一个购物的地方，更是一个承载着人情味和历史的空间。清晨时分，小贩们热情地招呼着客人，摊位前总是人来人往，充满了讨价还价的声音和新鲜食材的气息。许多家庭一代又一代在这里购买食材，从传统美食到创新菜式，菜市场的食材是餐桌上的主要来源。 虽然现代化的超市和线上购物逐渐兴起，但这个菜市场的独特魅力吸引了年轻一代的目光。他们不仅是来买菜，更是来感受这里的氛围，聆听长辈的故事，体验从父母那里耳熟能详的记忆场景。时间虽然改变了一些摊位的面貌，却改变不了市场上流淌的人情与传承的温暖。 这样一个地方，像是一部默默诉说着社区生活变化的纪录片，连接着过去、现在与未来。 #ayeritam #ayeritampenang #airitamwetmarket #地道菜市场 #槟城亚依淡 #槟城亚依淡巴杀 #槟城亚依淡菜市场 #槟城旅游

description: 上海装修设计🍃95后都喜欢的新中式风🔥 Hi~这里是画.上海装修设计,专注室内设计10年，打造独属于你的家🏡 今天给大家分享一套95后都爱的禅意韵味的新中式家装 现代风与传统的碰撞，擦出古典雅致的火花 原木与艺术的融合将自然特色保留，绿植、挂画、器物营造零距离自然感，清新舒适。 喜欢这份静谧空间，远离喧嚣，倾听内心，找回自己🍃 . 🏷️·玄关设计： 通顶原木柜设计，中间镂空收纳 旁设换鞋凳，实用又高级🕺 🏷️·客厅设计： 简约设计，木材与中式装饰彰显传统韵味。 天花板做回型吊顶，边带安装回型藏灯 小射灯灯辅助照明，黄色灯光营造复古氛围 米白墙面与浅灰瓷砖形成对比，木质家具更显质感🌲 🏷️·餐厅设计： 餐厅与客厅以木质镂空隔断，空间区划分自然和谐，保持整体空间的流畅感 每一处都恰好融合，每个空间尽显美感 餐桌采用原木材质，简约而大气，椅子则采用布艺与木质结合，既舒适又具质感 餐桌上方设置吊灯，营造温馨的就餐氛围 墙面中式画作或装饰品，增添文化气息 地面依旧采用浅灰瓷砖，与客厅保持一致，确保整体风格的协调统一🏡。 🏷️·卧室设计： 胡桃木地板沉稳温馨，浅色护墙板与地板和谐搭配 米色床头柜与被面展现素雅气质 绿植增添自然清新感🌿，营造轻松入睡的氛围🛌 . 不得不说，审美的尽头竟是新中式！ 整套房屋很耐看很古典禅意，无论是客厅还是餐厅，都展现出简约而不失韵味的设计 既简约实用，也高级美观，让人沉浸于传统文化的魅力与现代生活的舒适中🏡！ 希望你也喜欢~了解更多精彩案例，请移步主页~ . 画 𝑫𝑬𝑺𝑰𝑮𝑵 -原创设计 ▫️Base上海，Since2013 ▫️专注居家实用、温暖自然的设计 〰️ 全案设计｜纯设计|上海 住宅设计｜商业空间设计 · 现代风·极简风·新中式 法式风·侘寂风·混搭风 . ｜锦云江悦公寓｜云开月明华庭｜ ｜华玺名邸｜虹玺名邸｜海泰园｜鸿印里｜ ｜阳明花园广场二期｜新湖青蓝国际城二期｜ ｜中海和园｜保利誉庭｜云林名邸｜东方别墅｜ ｜申川名苑｜星耀名邸｜唐悦名邸｜海天名筑｜ ｜尚和茗庭｜斐丽名邸｜旗忠悦园｜璞悦名邸｜ ｜都汇名邸｜静悦名邸｜晋元华庭｜云玺名邸｜ #上海装修设计#上海装修 #血脉觉醒 #中国人血脉觉醒 #设计 #新中式风格 #新中式装修 #新中式 #装修案例 #室内设计 #我要上热门 #独立设计师 #装修 #装修改造 #上海设计师 #上海装修哪家好 #上海室内设计 #新中式风 #我的装修日记 #装修灵感库

description: Chevrolet Impala 1967 года – это культовый автомобиль, который стал символом американской автомобильной эпохи благодаря своему агрессивному дизайну, мощности и роскоши. Особенно известна версия 4-дверного хардтопа, получившая всемирную популярность благодаря сериалу "Supernatural". --- Основные характеристики Impala 1967 года 1. Дизайн и кузов Тип кузова: 2-дверное купе (Hardtop или Fastback). 4-дверный седан (Hardtop или стандартный). 4-дверный универсал. 2-дверный кабриолет. Отличительные черты: Широкая хромированная решетка радиатора. Узкие задние фонари (тройные встраиваемые в заднюю панель). Агрессивный профиль с длинным капотом и коротким багажником. Размеры: Длина: 5407 мм. Ширина: 2004 мм. Колесная база: 3023 мм. Высота: 1405 мм. Вес: ~1633–1900 кг (в зависимости от конфигурации). --- 2. Двигатели и их характеристики В 1967 году Chevrolet Impala предлагалась с широкой линейкой двигателей: Рядные шестицилиндровые (L6): 4.1L (250 куб. дюймов): 155 л.с. V8 (Small Block): 4.6L (283 куб. дюйма): 195 л.с. 5.4L (327 куб. дюйма): 275 л.с. V8 (Big Block): 6.5L (396 куб. дюйма): 325–375 л.с. 7.0L (427 куб. дюйма): 385–425 л.с. Примечание: Модель с 7.0L V8 могла разгоняться до 100 км/ч менее чем за 6 секунд. --- 3. Трансмиссия 3-ступенчатая механическая коробка передач (базовая). 4-ступенчатая механическая коробка передач (опция). 2-ступенчатая автоматическая коробка Powerglide. 3-ступенчатая автоматическая коробка Turbo Hydra-Matic (для мощных версий). --- 4. Подвеска и тормоза Передняя подвеска: независимая, на пружинах. Задняя подвеска: жесткая ось, пружинная. Тормоза: барабанные на всех колесах (дисковые тормоза – опция). --- 5. Интерьер Просторный и комфортный салон для 5–6 человек. Варианты отделки: ткань, винил, кожа (в зависимости от комплектации). Опции: кондиционер, AM/FM-радио, электрические стеклоподъемники. --- Популярность в культуре Самой знаменитой стала 4-дверная Impala Hardtop 1967 года, используемая в сериале "Сверхъестественное" (Supernatural). В сериале машина принадлежит Дину Винчестеру и стала своеобразным "членом семьи", символом приключений и борьбы с тьмой. Особенности модели из сериала: Двигатель: 7.0L V8 (Big Block). Цвет: черный с хромированными вставками. Модификации: скрытый отсек в багажнике для оружия и инструментов охотников. --- Chevrolet Impala 1967 года – это символ скорости, стиля и духа свободы, который до сих пор восхищает автолюбителей и поклонников американской классики.  #смешно #кружок #шутки #приколи #мемы #кружки #юмор #рофлы

description: Ganda ng view dito!! Sunsets + City lights!! 📍Kabesera Cafe — Eastridge Village, Angono, Rizal ❤️  Honest Review:  ☀️ the view is amazing, like super amazing :(( It felt like a breather!! i recommend visiting from sunset to night to see the city lights too!! 🍝 For food, my father and I ordered silog meals. They tasted just like how silog meals should be, so it was okay for both of us—no bad comments! My sister ordered pasta, and although it wasn’t bad, something could be added to improve it. The coffee was also okay compared to other overlooking cafés in Rizal. 💸 As for the prices, they’re on the pricey side! I guess you’re really paying extra for the view. The staff was accommodating, although we waited about 30 minutes for our orders. But given the number of people (around a hundred), it didn’t matter that much—we just spent the time appreciating nature, taking pictures, and having a great family moment. ‼️One thing I didn’t like was the entrance fee to Eastridge Village, the popular village in Rizal with lots of overlooking spots. For a four-wheel vehicle, they charge ₱100, ₱50 for motorcycles, and ₱30 for bikers. Isn’t ₱100 too much? Haha. As someone who has been here multiple times and knows that entrance used to be free if you showed your receipt, it’s quite shocking. 😍 Overall, still a great experience! The views really add 10,000x to the experience!! 🥰☀️ #cafe #OverlookingView #Rizal #AngonoRizal #WhenInRizal #motovlogger #roadtrip #citylights

description: Comment “PRICING” for my pricing-for-sales guide Same poster. Same hours. But Warner Brothers would never pay local cafe prices. Because price isn’t about the project. It’s about the stakes. When you price too low, you’re not being “fair” or “humble”.  You’re signaling: “This isn’t as important as you think it is.” And trust me — big clients don’t hire people who don’t take their problems seriously. If the outcome has high value to the client, Then helping them reach it should be high value to you, too.  That’s where your price comes from. Freelancers don’t get paid for time. We get paid to shoulder risk. To bring certainty. And the higher/heavier the stakes, the more you should be compensated. Price for that. P.S. description: 🌄 HUMBLE BEGINNINGS (2009-2011) 🌄 URBAN RETREAT by Acti-Labs started with nothing but a family’s determination to make a dream real. 🏠✨ In the beginning, they were a small lab making luxury products for exclusive spas, especially in Russia 🌍. When the economy crashed and exports were no longer viable, they made a bold choice: create their own brand and bring their passion for high-quality products directly to people. 💪🌟 Every team member stepped up—from cleaning floors to developing products—to ensure the dream would not die. 🌱 THE FOUNDATIONS (2011) 🌱 Running on sheer willpower 💸 and a belief in their products, the family launched ActiDerm in the UK in 2011 with just 11 skincare products, determined to keep their staff employed. 💖 Thanks to the courageous sellers who joined them at the start, Acti-Labs not only survived but began to thrive. 🌼 “Nothing is impossible. The word itself says, ‘I’m possible!’” —Audrey Hepburn 🌟 🚀 THE EXPANSION (2012) 🚀 With their business stabilized, new ambitions emerged. Now, Acti-Labs didn’t just want to avoid failure—they wanted to build a legacy. With a devoted team and a growing community of passionate consultants 🫂, they expanded beyond skincare and became “Acti-Labs,” opening a new facility in France dedicated solely to creating their own branded products. The dream had transformed into an unstoppable movement! 💪🌈 🌍 DARE TO DREAM (2021) 🌍 In 2021, amidst another global crisis, Acti-Labs saw incredible growth as the world moved online. But they wanted more than just online success; they dreamed of re-entering the professional beauty world with URBAN RETREAT products for spas, dermatologists, and professionals alike. This was no longer about growth—it was about evolution! 🌱🌟 🔥 DISASTER (2023) 🔥 Just as they were soaring, tragedy struck: a massive fire destroyed their UK warehouse. 💔🔥 But in true Acti-Labs spirit, they turned adversity into opportunity, moving operations entirely to France 🇫🇷. This setback became a powerful relaunch as they streamlined processes and introduced new products, emerging stronger than ever. 🌈💥 ✨ RISING FROM THE ASHES (2023) ✨ Now operating from France, Acti-Labs leaned into eco-friendly practices and a renewed commitment to quality. 🌿 This wasn’t just a comeback; it was a reinvention, with exciting new products and unmatched service. They were truly rising from the ashes! 🎉🔥 🌏 FORGING AHEAD (2024) 🌏 With unstoppable momentum, Acti-Labs expanded to Australia in March 2024 🇦🇺 and invested in advanced technology to create the ultimate online experience for their customers. Acti-Labs is more than a brand—it’s a community, a mission, and a journey that keeps evolving, driven by passion and resilience. 🌐💫

description: #musik #fyp #masayoshitakanaka #nujabes #godspeedyoublackemporer #tameimpala #kendricklamar #recommendation #samuraichamploo  Samurai Champloo is a critically acclaimed Japanese anime series created by Shinichirō Watanabe, who is also known for his work on Cowboy Bebop. First aired in 2004, the series is renowned for its innovative blend of historical Edo-period Japan with modern elements like hip-hop music, graffiti art, and breakdancing. This unique fusion sets Samurai Champloo apart in the anime world, offering both a stylistically fresh and narratively rich experience. The story revolves around three main characters: Fuu, a spirited and headstrong young woman; Mugen, a wild, unpredictable swordsman with a fighting style inspired by capoeira and hip-hop movements; and Jin, a calm and disciplined ronin who adheres to traditional samurai values. Fuu convinces the two fighters, who initially clash violently upon meeting, to accompany her on a journey across Japan to find a mysterious samurai who “smells of sunflowers.” This quest forms the backbone of the series, though each episode often feels self-contained, resembling an anthology. What truly distinguishes Samurai Champloo is its genre-bending nature. Watanabe merges the aesthetics of Edo-period Japan with contemporary culture in ways that are both humorous and thought-provoking. For instance, the soundtrack, composed largely by the late Nujabes, mixes lo-fi hip-hop beats with traditional Japanese instruments, creating a sonic identity that is as unique as the visuals. This fusion mirrors the series’ thematic exploration of tradition versus innovation, order versus chaos, and personal freedom versus social constraint. The animation style is dynamic and fluid, particularly in the fight scenes, which are choreographed with cinematic flair. Mugen’s erratic and dance-like combat style contrasts sharply with Jin’s elegant and precise swordplay, visually reflecting their conflicting personalities. Fuu serves as the emotional anchor between them, often providing comic relief or moments of human warmth amid the violence and uncertainty of their travels. Despite its historical setting, Samurai Champloo frequently breaks the fourth wall and plays with anachronisms. Episodes include references to baseball, graffiti battles, and even zombie outbreaks, all while maintaining a coherent world. These elements serve not just as stylistic quirks but as commentary on the universality of certain human experiences—violence, ambition, friendship, and the search for meaning. At its core, Samurai Champloo is a story about unlikely companionship and the personal growth that occurs through shared hardship. The trio’s journey is as much internal as it is external, with each character grappling with their past and what kind of future they might want. The show concludes in an open-ended yet satisfying way, staying true to its philosophical tone and refusal to conform to easy resolutions. In summary, Samurai Champloo is a masterclass in genre hybridization, combining action, drama, comedy, and music in a visually and sonically striking package. It remains a standout in anime not just for its style, but for its depth, making it a lasting favorite among fans and critics alike.

description: 📍One Twelve Caffe | Downey, CA ⏰ Everyday 7 am - 8 pm  Follow @janelleatsocal for more foodie finds, things to do, and matcha reviews !⋆౨ৎ˚⟡˖ I just found another one of my favorite cafes located in Downey ♡. I love not just the food but the service as well ! Right when we walked in we were greeted and all the staff were so friendly :). There’s so many different options to choose from it was hard not to order the whole menu xD. ☆ What we ordered:  - pistachio cream croissant - white macadamia crookie  - cookie butter croissant  - banana matcha  - biscoff cookie latte - chicken and pesto sandwich  - spicy chicken alfredo  The pistachio cream croisssnt had chocolate filling & wasn’t too sweet. The croissants had the perfect fluffy texture! If you love cookie butter you have to try their lotus croissant & biscoff cookie latte 😍. The banana matcha is a new item and I loved how you can print any picture onto your drink! I couldn’t choose what to pick and they chose winnie the pooh and it shocked me when it came bc i actually really like the character aha . Aside from its aesthetics it’s a bit on the sweeter side but you can really taste the flavors of both banana and matcha!  The food was also really good and with the portions. I would definitely be coming back to try their breakfast menu items such as their famous crepes only available before 2 pm.  💌 Thank you for having me! @One Twelve Caffe ♡ 🗓️: 5/7/25 ────────────୨ৎ───────────  #lafoodie #downeyca #downey #ocfoodie #fyp ##foryoupage #lacafe #dubaichocolate #ugc #foodiereview #matcha #bananamatcha  #dubaichocolatestrawberries #matchalover #cafehopping #downeyca #lacafe

description: Explore the vibrant community of Seneca Village, a 19th-century enclave of free Black landowners nestled in what is now Central Park. Founded in 1825, this diverse neighborhood boasted over 200 residents, including African Americans, Irish, and Germans, who built a life complete with houses, schools, and churches.  It was a rare setting where Black New Yorkers could own land and exercise their right to vote. Tragically, in 1857, the city displaced its residents to make way for Central Park, erasing their legacy.  Today, we honor and remember Seneca Village as an essential chapter in New York's history. Discover its rich heritage through historical maps, illustrations, and modern memorials that pay tribute to this lost community.  #SenecaVillage #BlackHistory #CentralPark #NewYorkHistory #CommunityLegacy.

description: 【世界の住宅】フォスターシティー アメリカ、カリフォルニア州の「フォスターシティー（Foster City）」は、サンフランシスコ・ベイエリアに位置する美しいウォーターフロントの計画都市です。この街は、ラグーン（運河）を中心に設計され、水辺の景観が魅力的な高級住宅地として知られています。 『エリアの特徴』 •ラグーンと水辺の住宅:  街の中心にはラグーンが流れ、住民は庭から直接ラグーンにアクセスできる住宅もあります。ヨットやカヌーなどの水上アクティビティも楽しめます。 •治安と教育環境:  小中学校の教育レベルが高く、治安が良いため、家族連れに人気があります。 •利便性:  サンフランシスコダウンタウンまで車で約30分、日本食スーパーや補習校へのアクセスも良好です。 『住宅』 ・一戸建て住宅:  平均価格は約1,500,000～2,500,000ドルで、築年数や立地によって変動します。 •アパートメント:  1～2ベッドルームの物件で、価格は約700,000～1,200,000ドルが相場です。 •賃貸物件:  3ベッドルームの一戸建て賃料は月額3,500～4,500ドル程度です。 『概要』 •生活環境:  公園やスポーツ施設が充実しており、住民同士の交流も盛んです。ラグーン沿いには散歩道や広場が整備されています。 •産業:  IT企業や日系企業が多く集まるエリアで、駐在員にも人気があります。 フォスターシティーは、美しい景観と利便性を兼ね備えた快適な生活環境を提供し、家族連れや企業駐在員にとって理想的な居住地です。 #高級 #住宅街 #アメリカ #america

description: 🇲🇾这家Cheras的牛杂，也太好吃了🤤 今天介绍给你们一家Cheras的隐藏牛杂店，真的特别好吃！刚刚才听老板说，卤味的做法是跟🇨🇳师傅学来的，难怪那么香、那么入味。🤤 沙煲牛杂 真的是完全被惊艳到！牛肉滑嫩到不行，配上浓郁又香的汤底，简直绝配。牛筋Q弹软糯，完全没有腥味，肉质新鲜，和汤底融合得刚刚好，吃第一口就爱上了。 沙煲卤鸡脚 鸡脚卤得超入味，咬下去软糯又有Q感，卤汁香气十足，不咸不油腻，越嚼越香，真的越吃越上瘾。 卤套（鸡腿，豆腐，鸡蛋） 鸡腿软嫩入味，豆腐吸满卤汁，咸香适中，鸡蛋是老卤做法，蛋黄不会干，一整套配白饭，真的超级下饭。 除了卤味、牛杂，这里还有猪肉圆面、鱼圆面、牛肉丸面而且竟然还有牛肉、羊肉、鸡肉水饺，选择超多！不管想吃饭、吃面、还是点小吃，这里都能满足。 而且老板人很好，蛮健谈的，聊几句就觉得很亲切，让人吃得开心，心情也特别好。 📍蕉赖茶餐室 RESTORAN KAFE CHERAS 528-G, Batu 3 1/4, Jln Cheras, Taman Pertama, Cheras, 56100 🕰️ 16pm-12am #隐藏美食 #Cheras美食 #吉隆坡探店 #马来西亚必吃 #吃货的天堂 #本地吃货必试 #美食控必看 #超火美食店 #吃货种草 #牛杂控必试

first trip to China 🇨🇳, this 10-day itinerary covers the most iconic cities, rich culture, amazing food, and stunning landscapes! ⸻ Day 1-2: Beijing | 北京 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	Great Wall of China 咸味煎饼，中国特色街头小吃 ⸻ Day 3-4: Xi’an | 西安 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	Terracotta Army — The world-famous ancient clay soldiers 兵马俑 — 世界著名的古代陶俑军队 	•	Big Wild Goose Pagoda — A Buddhist landmark with historical significance 大雁塔 — 具有历史意义的佛教地标 	•	Ancient City Wall — One of the best-preserved city walls in China, perfect for cycling 古城墙 — 中国保存最完整的古城墙之一，非常适合骑行 Must-try food | 必尝美食 	•	Rou Jia Mo — A flavorful Chinese-style burger 肉夹馍 — 鲜香四溢的中国汉堡 	•	Yang Rou Pao Mo — Lamb soup with crumbled flatbread 羊肉泡馍 — 羊肉汤泡入碎馍，风味独特 	•	Biang Biang Noodles — Wide, chewy noodles with spicy sauce 油泼面 — 宽厚劲道的面条，配上香辣酱料 ⸻ Day 5-6: Chengdu | 成都 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding — The best place to see pandas 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地 — 观赏大熊猫的最佳地点 	•	Jinli Ancient Street — Traditional Sichuan-style streets with great food and souvenirs 锦里古街 — 充满四川特色的传统街区，美食与手工艺品丰富 	•	Wuhou Shrine — A cultural site dedicated to Zhuge Liang and the Three Kingdoms period 武侯祠 — 纪念诸葛亮和三国历史的文化遗址 Must-try food | 必尝美食 	•	Hot Pot — Sichuan-style spicy hot pot with numbing peppercorns 火锅 — 四川麻辣火锅，香辣过瘾 	•	Mapo Tofu — Spicy tofu dish with minced meat 麻婆豆腐 — 麻辣嫩滑的豆腐配碎肉 	•	Dan Dan Noodles — Savory and spicy sesame-based noodles 担担面 — 口感丰富的麻辣芝麻面 ⸻ Day 7: Chongqing | 重庆 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	Hongya Cave — A riverside district with beautiful night views and street food 洪崖洞 — 依山而建的滨江景区，夜景迷人，街头小吃丰富 	•	Yangtze River Cableway — Get an aerial view of the Yangtze River and the city skyline 长江索道 — 乘坐索道俯瞰长江与城市全景 Must-try food | 必尝美食 	•	Chongqing Hot Pot — Extra spicy and flavorful hot pot 重庆火锅 — 麻辣鲜香的火锅体验 	•	Chongqing Noodles — Spicy, mouth-numbing noodles 重庆小面 — 麻辣劲道的小面 ⸻ Day 8-9: Shanghai | 上海 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	The Bund — A waterfront area with stunning skyline views and historic buildings 外滩 — 沿江步道，拥有壮观的天际线和历史建筑 	•	Yu Garden — A beautifully designed traditional Chinese garden 豫园 — 设计精美的传统江南园林 	•	Shanghai Tower — The tallest skyscraper in China with an observation deck 上海中心大厦 — 中国最高的摩天大楼，观景台视野极佳 Must-try food | 必尝美食 	•	Xiao Long Bao — Soup-filled dumplings 小笼包 — 汤汁丰富的小笼包 	•	Sheng Jian Bao — Pan-fried dumplings with a crispy bottom 生煎包 — 底部焦脆的煎包 ⸻ Day 10: Hangzhou | 杭州 Must-visit | 必游景点 	•	West Lake — A scenic lake famous for its beautiful landscape 西湖 — 以美丽景色著称的湖泊，适合乘船游览 	•	Lingyin Temple — A historic Buddhist temple with stunning carvings 灵隐寺 — 历史悠久的佛教寺庙，石雕精美 Must-try food | 必尝美食 	•	Longjing Tea — One of China’s finest green teas 龙井茶 — 中国最优质的绿茶之一 	•	Dongpo Pork — A slow-braised pork belly dish 东坡肉 — 慢炖五花肉，肥而不腻 ⸻ Pro Tips | 旅行小贴士 ✅ Public transport is convenient — Use metros, high-speed trains, and description: [Review] This is the first time we came across a fine dining restaurant nestled within an industrial area. It offers artisanal bakes in the morning and having heard good reviews of their Pistachio Croissant, we were there to check it out! The exterior of this croissant was encrusted with a huge amount of nuts, giving it a very aromatic and crunchy texture, while being buttery on the inside. The pistachio spread within is creamy and tasty, though of a thinner consistency than I expected. Nevertheless, I considered it value for money at $5 a piece as it is rather hearty and delicious. The smaller sized black sesame croissant (required to be purchased in a pair) came with sweet black sesame custard filling and dessicated coconut to add a light crunch to the exterior. I love the thicker custard cream consistency (as compared to the pistachio croissant) and find the taste very comforting! For a savoury option, we had a hard time deciding between the potato and turkey ham or the chicken curry in bolo bun. We decided to go for the former and glad to say it was not a bad choice. This savoury bun was served to us with the ingredients warm on the inside, which made the eating experience more enjoyable. If you like a classic bun, this is worth a try. Another classic we went for was the tubular shaped butter croissant, which was crispy and lightly sweet. We took the friendly server’s suggestion to dip this croissant in coffee (we went for unsweetened cappuccino) and it tasted awesome! A new way to enjoy croissant for us. Overall, we had a great breakfast at Sonder and would recommend. Do note that the Pistachio Croissant sold out really fast so you may want to visit early if you are keen to try it. description: Free art?? In THIS economy? Insane, I know! I thought this would be a fun, semi-monthly thing where I’ll draw your guys’ OCs to try out a variety of art styles while giving back to the community I’m building here! Please read the whole post so we’re all on the same page 💕 ✨RULES✨ 🍓 FOLLOWERS ONLY! I obviously can’t keep track, so it’s more of an honor code, but please don’t follow with the intent to unfollow as soon as you get some free stuff— there’s no guarantee you’ll get anything, as this is a sort of random selection process! 🍓 ONLY ONE ENTRY A MONTH, but you can put as many OCs in the post as you’d like! Just be sure to give as clear of reference as possible, as design clarity will lead to a more accurate depiction! DO NOT TRY TO UPLOAD ON MULTIPLE SOCIALS OR YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED! 🍓 YOU CAN ONLY BE SELECTED ONCE! I want people to have a fair shot, please don’t try to get around that. 🍓 I CAN DRAW IN ANY ART STYLE I CHOOSE! I’m using this as an exploration of my art, and since it’s free, I want creative liberty in this! While I play to mainly do headshots, I may do more of the character depending on chance and how much free time I have that month! But you are at minimum getting a headshot if you win :) 🍓 PLEASE CREDIT MY ART IF YOU USE IT! Whether it be an icon or a reference for another artist, ALWAYS credit my work if you use it! It should go for any artists’ work you use! 🍓 Less of a rule and more of an expectation, but I at minimum, I’ll do these ONCE A MONTH! I might do more if I feel like it, but that’s not a promise! Not trying to  stress myself over a fun project :) 🍓 Last, but not least, PLEASE DON’T TAG ME! Just use the hashtag #bxwiefreeartfriday to enter your submission!, I’d rather not get spammed for these please!! To avoid my notification unnecessarily filling up, YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED IF I AM TAGGED, just use the hashtag :) I know this is a lengthy list, but it’s free art, so I wanna make the boundaries clear so we can have a TON of fun with this new series! description: From Garage Roaster to $700M Coffee Empire: James Freeman's Blue Bottle ☕🔵 James Freeman wasn't a business expert. In 2002, as a struggling classical clarinetist in Oakland, California, he was frustrated with the dark, bitter coffee that dominated the market. He started roasting small batches of beans in a 183-square-foot potting shed and selling them at farmers markets within 48 hours of roasting. When Starbucks and other chains were focused on consistency and convenience, Blue Bottle emphasized freshness, origin, and meticulous preparation methods. The breakthrough came from their contrarian approach to café design. While other coffee shops maximized seating and efficiency, Blue Bottle opened tiny, architect-designed spaces with limited hours and often no WiFi. By 2017, Nestlé acquired a majority stake in Blue Bottle at a $700 million valuation. What strategies drove their remarkable success? Create Scarcity Through Quality Standards: Their commitment to serving coffee only at peak freshness (within 48 hours of roasting) created a sense of urgency and exclusivity. Slow Down When Others Speed Up: While competitors focused on quick service, Blue Bottle embraced time-consuming brewing methods that produced superior results. Design Spaces That Embody Your Values: Their minimalist cafés with clean lines and uncluttered aesthetics physically represented their philosophy of focusing on coffee without distractions. Freeman's story demonstrates that sometimes going against industry trends creates extraordinary opportunities. By emphasizing quality and craft when the coffee industry was racing toward convenience and scale, he built a brand that transformed how millions of people experience their daily coffee ritual. #BlueBottle #SpecialtyCoffee #ThirdWaveCoffee #CoffeeRoaster #CafeDesign #EntrepreneurJourney #CraftCoffee #PremiumBrands #FoodBeverage #AcquisitionSuccess

description: 咬定青山不放松， 立根原在破岩中。 题材：步步高升 [产品特点]：一块原料，整体雕刻，纯手工真光。 [产品介绍]：本摆件采用天然中东古青玉石制作，挑选玉质优美之玉石，经精心雕刻而成，太湖石和竹子都是中国传统文化中的重要元素，它们在历史和文化中都有着深厚的意义。太湖石被视为富贵的象征，并且"石” 谐音"时”有“时来运转"的寓意。太湖石以其美坚硬的特点，与竹子相结合，象征着坚如磐石和节节高升的寓意。 竹子在中国文化中有着极高的地位，被赋予了君子的人格象征，代表着谦虛、有气节、刚直不阿、不怕威逼利诱、坚持自我等品质。竹子的空心代表虛怀若谷的品格，其枝弯而不折，象征着柔中有刚的做人原则。竹子的四季常青则象征着顽强的生命力和青春永驻。 竹子与太湖石相映成趣，共同营造出一份静谧与和谐。当微风拂过，竹叶轻轻摇曳，发出沙沙的声响，仿佛是大自然的低语，让人感受到一种难以言喻的宁静与美好。
